title: Lab - Imperative commands
description: Do everything from the command line, fast.
scenario: Do everything from the command line, fast. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Pod with labels
tasks.instructions: Create a Pod named redis with image redis:alpine and label tier=db in one command.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Service in one line
tasks.instructions: Create a ClusterIP Service redis-service on port 6379 for that Pod.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Deployment with namespace
tasks.instructions: Create namespace dev-ns and a Deployment redis-deploy there with 2 replicas.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create ns dev-ns
kubectl create deployment redis-deploy --image=redis -n dev-ns --replicas=2
